title: Find suppliers
subtitle: Describe what you need. Review the evidence, supplier role, and available contacts before reaching out.
queryLabel: What do you need to procure?
okpd2Hint: Provide a code if you know it. The system will also suggest codes from historical matches.
regionHint: Two digits. This reflects registration, not delivery capability.
lotOption: Analyze existing procurement by Lot ID
invalidRegion: Enter a two-digit region code or leave it blank.
resultsSubtitle: Historical suppliers and curated external candidates are shown separately.
categoryUncertain: We could not identify the procurement category with high confidence. Supplier results are exploratory; check the OKPD2 code before contacting suppliers.
sparseWarning: Historical evidence for this category is sparse. Review supplier evidence carefully.
mismatchWarning: The query text and provided OKPD2 appear mismatched. Check the category before contacting suppliers.
noHistorical: No historical suppliers were returned for this search.
externalSubtitle: External verification is separate from procurement history.
noExternal: No curated external evidence is available for this category. This does not mean no external suppliers exist.
poolHealthy: Historical supplier pool is relatively distributed
poolUnavailable: Pool health is unavailable for this category.
priceUnavailable: Comparable supplier-level price data is not available yet.
exportWaiting: JSON/CSV export will be available when the backend export endpoint is enabled.
error: Could not load supplier results. Try again.
rankingTextOnly: Ranked by text and semantic evidence (no OKPD2 code)
verifiedNotApproval: “Verified” means the evidence was confirmed — it is not vendor approval or a guarantee of award suitability.
